title: A Genome-Wide Association Study for Neonatal Diseases
brief_summary: This is an observational study to identify genetic risks for neonatal diseases, necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) using genome-wide association study (GWAS) and enterotype investigation. We hypothesize that specific genetic factors and microbiome could predispose preterm neonates for the development of NEC.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Chinese infants admitted in the neonatal unit (NNU)

Exclusion Criteria:

Refuse consent for study
